items: P2.1 (third retained unit: reclaim-path template scan removal)
title: zero_states reclaim memsets issued directly (template scan removed)

host.cpu: AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 395 w/ Radeon 8060S

attribution.method: Phase-count instrumentation of the C1 prefill arm (22 requests): 22 prefill (433 ms avg) + 22 delivery/reclaim decode passes (45 ms avg); py-spy leaf attribution inside the decode pass: _zero 856/900 ms (~39 ms/request) - the per-buffer np.all(zeros == 0) host scan over immutable state-sized templates before every memset (~96 buffers/request).
attribution.templates: conv_zero/recurrent_zero are np.zeros arrays constructed once at allocation (qwen35_gguf_runner.py:28450-28453) and never mutated; buffers are allocated from those template sizes, so every _zero call took the memset branch after rescanning the same constant.

change.summary: zero_states issues state-buffer memsets directly (async on the given stream, sync on stream 0 - the same branch _zero would have taken), removing the per-call host template scan. Bytes written are identical; no arithmetic, ordering, or ownership change. _zero is unchanged for its other callers.
